rows.01:1288:
Then one day, that guy Yoshioka came to me, saying he wanted to talk something over with me.
Yoshioka was a gloomy guy who always kept to himself, always alone.
I never hung out with him.
He didn't stand out, and I didn't particularly care what he got up to.
He was the kind of guy you could hardly tell was there or not.
And this Yoshioka says he wants my advice.
I think that was probably the first time he'd ever spoken to me.
I didn't have any reason to turn him down, and when someone goes out of his way to ask for advice, you can't exactly refuse to listen, right?
So I heard him out.
At first he just fidgeted, but eventually he started mumbling, like it was hard for him to say.{p}What do you think he talked about?
rows.01:22b8:
"I've been waiting. Now we'll get to see the spirit world."
Saying stuff like that, Yoshioka was way creepier than any ghost.
"They say the spirit world shows itself in all kinds of forms.
There's no telling what form it'll take in front of us until the moment comes."{p}
rows.01:2414:
It was a round compact mirror, the kind a woman would carry.
He kept flashing it at me.
"At 3:33 and 33 seconds in the middle of the night, you hold a mirror you use every day up to the one on the landing.
Then the two mirrors reflect each other, and you can see something mysterious in them.
And not just see it. Something might even come out. I can't wait."
But his face was blank as he said it; he didn't look like he was enjoying it at all.{p}
rows.01:2590:
The school at night is freaking scary.
Even the new building is creepy, and we were headed for the old one.
You can imagine how scary that was, right?
Even a haunted house isn't that scary.
Yoshioka had more guts than you'd think.
Even I was pretty freaked out, but he just strode right along at a brisk pace.
He kept pushing deeper and deeper into the pitch-black school with nothing but one dim flashlight.
It was all I could do to keep up.{p}
rows.01:2740:
Even inside the old building, he didn't flinch once.
At night, the sound of your steps on the floorboards is really loud.
Creak, creak, creak, creak. A sound like fingernails scratching glass echoes all around you.
You can't hear anything else, right?
So that sound really grates on your ears.
And the musty smell of old, rotting wood that you hardly notice in the daytime, at night you can smell it clearly.
When you breathe in, that smell is all there is, filling your mouth, thick and stifling.{p}
rows.01:3798:
Oh yeah?
You want me to tell you, huh?
All right then, I'll tell you.
Whatever I say, don't freak out.
And whatever I say, accept that it's your fate and give up.
Your face is...{p}
rows.01:57ec:
So he came to me for advice.
But do you think I'd believe a story like that?
The more serious Yoshioka looked as he talked, the funnier I found it.
It was all I could do to keep from laughing.
"Please. All you have to do is come with me.
The school in the middle of the night is scary when you're alone.
Please, I'm begging you, come with me."
I was getting pretty fed up.
He was being such a pest about it that I said it offhand, just to get rid of him.
"Yeah, sure. I'll be waiting in front of the school gate at three."
That's what I said.
He gave me this creepy, happy grin.
Now that I think about it, that was the first time I'd ever seen him smile.
The first and last smile I ever saw on him.{p}
rows.01:65dc:
Then he let out a sigh and muttered just one thing.
"I'm scared."
That's all.
The old building is scary even in the daytime, and he was terrified of going there alone in the middle of the night.
So that's why he came to me for advice.
"Please. All you have to do is come with me.
The school in the middle of the night is scary when you're alone.
Please, I'm begging you, come with me."
Sure enough, here it came.
And Meguro had managed it on her own, I bet...
Well, it was a little out there, but it sounded like an interesting story.
So I gave him a casual answer.
"Yeah, sure. I'll be waiting in front of the school gate at three."
That's what I said.
He gave me this creepy, happy grin.
Now that I think about it, that was the first time I'd ever seen him smile.
That's how bad he was at showing his feelings.{p}
rows.01:6d4c:
It was when I got to the spot where you can see that mirror if you go up these stairs.
Someone had gotten there before me.
And let me tell you, it wasn't Yoshioka.
Yoshioka was already in front of the mirror.
This someone was hiding pretty close to Yoshioka, keeping dead still.
Well, I'll get to that someone later.
I hid even farther back, where I could keep watch on the two of them.
I've got good eyesight, and I can see well in the dark.
So it was no problem.{p}
rows.01:7758:
Ever since the next day, Yoshioka's been coming to school like normal.
Though everybody says he's like a different person.
It's the one who switched places that's been coming.
Every day, I get this feeling I'm being watched.
Whenever I look up, I catch them looking at me.
Until today, I haven't told anyone about this.
Normally, nobody would believe a story like this.
But if they find out what I've told you here today...
You and I might not get out of this in one piece.
...So, yeah, that's the end of my story.
Sorry, but since the mirror got smashed, I don't know what happened to the real Yoshioka.
I hope he got to see Meguro on the other side of the mirror.
So, who's telling the next one...?{p}
rows.01:7a20:
The school at night was creepy.
I wondered what I'd do if Yoshioka wasn't there, but he was.
He was standing in front of the school gate, staring blankly, just like a ghost.
Holding a flashlight.
When he spotted me, he came over, waving the flashlight in his hand.
He could at least have smiled, but he didn't crack even a hint of one.
Maybe he was nervous; his face was damp with sweat, and he just looked at me with no expression at all.
"Thank you. I knew you'd come.
I'll never forget this as long as I live."
He said that and gripped my hand as hard as he could.
I'm too nice for my own good, huh?
I believed a story like this and came all the way to the school.{p}

rows.01:9764:
In that instant.
I couldn't believe my eyes.
Meguro's face, smiling so sweetly until then, twisted into a horrible face like a demon's.
And then she thrust the upper half of her body out of the mirror and sank her teeth into Yoshioka's throat.
"Why did you betray me?
I loved you. Why didn't you come with me?"
That thick, coarse voice didn't sound like a woman's at all.
"...No... I didn't... betray you..."
Yoshioka was writhing in agony.
Maybe because she was biting his throat, his voice wouldn't come out. Air just wheezed out of him.
"It's cold. It hurts.
My body's all twisted, and this world is nothing but pain and agony!"
Meguro, changed beyond recognition, screamed that and dragged Yoshioka into the mirror in one go.
Like sinking into water, Yoshioka's body sank down into the mirror, deeper and deeper.
It all happened in the blink of an eye.
I couldn't stop it, and I couldn't save him.{p}
rows.01:9d24:
Yoshioka is inside that mirror.
I don't know if he's alive or dead, but he went into that mirror.
Was it Meguro, changed beyond recognition, that dragged him in, or some other creature, a monster from another dimension? I don't know.
And that happy laughter of Meguro's that Yoshioka said he heard in his room.
Maybe the truth is, Meguro's living happily somewhere else.
Or was she just pretending to be happy on purpose, to lure out Yoshioka, who'd betrayed her?
At this point, there's no way to know anything, I guess.{p}
rows.01:aca8:
And then we waited for the time to come.
With the mirror Yoshioka brought facing the mirror on the landing.
"What the hell is that? Looks like something a woman would use."
That's what I said.
I felt uneasy if I wasn't talking about something.
I had a feeling something truly terrifying might actually happen.
What Yoshioka had brought was a dingy old round makeup mirror.
Apparently it was from the bathroom at his house.
He said it was the mirror he used a lot, like after a bath.
And while we were talking, three o'clock, thirty-three minutes, thirty-three seconds...
The moment came.{p}So what do you think happened?
rows.01:aed0:
"Wh-what is this★"
Yoshioka suddenly shouted.
I looked in the mirror too, and it gave me a real shock.
There was a horrible face in the mirror.
A sinister face, like a demon's, you could say...
But, see, if you looked real close, it looked like Yoshioka.
What's more, when Yoshioka looked up, it looked up,
and when he talked, it opened its mouth.
Everything Yoshioka did, it did too, just like that.
In other words, it was Yoshioka's own reflection in the mirror.
Though whether he ever realized that...
"That's weird. The book didn't say anything about this."
The way he was going on, I guess he hadn't realized.
"That's enough, isn't it? We saw something weird."
I said that for Yoshioka's sake, more or less.
Before he figured out that the thing in the mirror was himself, you know.
Well, I didn't want to see my own reflection either, so I wanted to get out of there fast.
...That's right, I got away without seeing myself in the mirror.
Between the bad angle and Yoshioka being in the way, well, I got lucky.
But in the end, Yoshioka didn't want to leave.
Fine, whatever.
If that's how he wanted it, he could suit himself.{p}
rows.01:b3c4:
The next day, I went up to Yoshioka first thing in the morning.
"So what happened last night in the end?"
I asked him.
"I went home right after you did. The demon disappeared, see."
Yoshioka answered, just like that.
"The book said an angel would appear in that mirror, but I guess it was a load of nonsense after all."
An angel, huh. So that's why Yoshioka wouldn't leave back then.
If I'd heard that, I'd probably have waited a while longer myself.
Keep secrets like that, and your heart gets twisted and you end up looking like a demon.
Get mixed up with a guy like that and you could end up in serious trouble, so after that I cut off all contact with Yoshioka.
Yoshioka stopped coming near me, too.
He looked at me with eyes that were clearly scared.{p}
rows.01:cc7c:
That's right, it came out.
A demon...
Hold on, what's with that look?
You don't believe me?
I'm not lying, so hear me out a little longer.
Out of one of all the mirrors reflected in the facing mirrors, a demon appeared.
The demon had long hair hanging limp, and it looked like the corpse of a beautiful woman.
It stared hard at us, and the first thing out of its mouth was this:
"Hand... want to drink..."
Drink a hand?
You wouldn't get what that meant either, right?
While I was puzzling over it, Yoshioka suddenly came out with this:
"You want to drink... the blood from a hand?"
At that, the demon smiled sweetly.
I couldn't tell if I was scared or my heart was racing for some other reason; it was a weird feeling.
Then Yoshioka staggered toward the demon and held out his arm.{p}So what do you think I did?
